entry_risk.note: Original trigger levels are an entry-quality benchmark, not a change to G7 stops or targets.

risk_budget_basis: Inherited Rs100000 capital per entry * 5 leverage * 1.2 percent initial stop; candidate includes modeled roundtrip fees within this budget.
risk_cap_basis: Two inherited per-entry risk budgets; includes already-open initial stop risk and fees, no assumption that a future protective stop has armed.

acceptance.independent_validation: REQUIRED_FOR_ANY_PROMOTION; reused history cannot pass this requirement

inherited_rules: +0.1 percent gross protection after completed +0.6 percent close
G7 ranking and selected pending-order quotas
limitations: Same inherited stock-day universe as G7; future OI coverage affects historical eligibility. This experiment does not repair omitted raw candidates.
All 59 source sessions were previously inspected; chronological blocks are diagnostics, not independent holdouts.
Execution-risk checks occur after ranking. Rejected pending orders do not receive replacement candidates, matching the declared G10 contract.
One-minute OHLC cannot establish intrabar sequence, spread, queue position, broker latency, or actual live execution.
Risk limits describe modeled stop risk; adverse gaps can exceed it.

inspiration.usage: Adapt concepts only; use existing NSE data and native G7 execution, not the US-only broker or ORB simulator.
